messages.content: Calculate the magnetic field produced by a wire carrying a current of 4 amps with a distance of 2 m from the wire. And find the voltage difference of a region in the direction of the electric field that is 3 m apart, assuming the electric field is 5 N/C.

function.name: calculate_voltage_difference
function.description: Calculate the voltage difference between two points in an electric field. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

electric_field.description: The electric field in newtons per coulomb. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The distance between the two points in the direction of the field in meters. This is a float type value.

charge.description: The charge of the test particle, typically an electron, in coulombs. Default to 0 This is a float type value.

function.name: calculate_magnetic_field
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field produced by a current-carrying wire. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

current.description: The current in the wire in amperes. This is a float type value.

distance.description: The perpendicular distance from the wire in meters. This is a float type value.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space, a constant value. Default 0.1 This is a float type value.
